items.note: be 动词用对，句尾补句号。

items.userAnswer: My name is zane.I am a student now,liked my English teacher Amy.She is a kind teacher.But she always is busy.
items.revisedAnswer: My name is Zane. I am a student now, and I like my English teacher, Amy. She is a kind teacher, but she is always busy.
items.errorNote: 四处：①大小写——zane 是人名，首字母大写；②标点——zane.I 句号后缺空格（同类第 2 次）；③标点+语法——now,liked 逗号连接两个完整句子（应用句号或加 and），且 liked 是过去式，「现在喜欢」用原形 like；④语法——she always is busy 频度副词 always 要放在 be 动词之后。任务完成度另记：are 未用到，也未介绍朋友。
items.targetPoint: 书写规范 + be 动词 + 频度副词位置
